Name: Hootin' and Hollerin'
Author: 7thAxis
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/JwzT12V9/ff143cffa46866829d4c53a252facc3f12de83f6da39a3ee5e6b4b0d3255bfef95601890afd80709da39a3ee5e6b4b0d3255.png[/img]
[i][size=5][/size][/i][size=5]🦉 [/size][i][size=5]An Owl Farm Animal Expansion[/size][/i][size=5]🦉 [/size][/center]

Welcome to [i]Hootin' & Hollerin'[/i], a mod that allows you to forage up owl eggs and hatch them on your farm! There are 8 unique species with 32 different variants to find and nurture! You don't only get owls, however. You also get new animal produce, crafting recipes for certain vanilla items that don't have them, a custom Aviary by BogWyytch, a new warp totem and much much more!

[b][size=5]Features:[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]New Farm Animals[/size][/b]
8 new owl farm animals, each with 4 color variants and unique drops.
You can find one owl species per season, and four in special locations!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JWsZGNzD/Owl-Models.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/nqpxFyNW/Barn.gif[/img] [img]https://i.ibb.co/KxgxMddm/Barred.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/DfCvCWfJ/Screech.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/bjZj7nCd/Snowy.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ttHy1Jx/Burrowing.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/rRQnQk1x/Owl-Models.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/B2fxzHxD/Owl-Models.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/bjrshLNq/Owl-Models.gif[/img]
[list]
[quote][*][b][u]Barn Owl [/u][/b]- Egg spawns in spring on the Forest, Mountain and Backwoods maps
[*][b][u]Barred Owl[/u][/b]  - Egg spawns in summer on the Forest, Mountain and Backwoods maps
[*][b][u]Screech Owl[/u] [/b] - Egg spawns in Fall on the Forest, Mountain and Backwoods maps
[*][b][u]Snowy Owl[/u][/b]  - Egg spawns in Winter on the Forest, Mountain and Backwoods maps
[*][b][u]Burrowing Owl[/u][/b] - Egg spawns in the Desert & Skull cave entrance year round
[*][b][u]Swamp Owl[/u][/b] - Egg spawns in the Witch's Swamp, Secret woods and on Spirit's Eve
[*][b][u]Spectacled Owl[/u][/b] - Egg spawns on Ginger Island and on the Luau
[*][b][u]Stilt Owl[/u][/b] - Egg spawns inside a new uncommon ore node at the Ginger Island bone quarry 
[*]If SVE or East Scarp are installed, they will also have a chance of spawning on their maps
[/quote][/list]
[b][size=4]Items[/size][/b]
[spoiler]
[quote]• 32 unique foragable eggs, hatchable in either a Large Incubator or the Aviary.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/TDFyCzpH/Eggs-Sheet.png[/img]

• 9 colored owl feathers for crafting new recipes.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/CKGWGkj4/Feathers-Sheet.png[/img]﻿

• Owl Mayonnaise, Cindersap Warp Totem and How To Paint Owls

[img]https://i.ibb.co/jPF4R40W/Misc-Sheet.png[/img]

• Owl Paintings

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QBkbL0P/Paintings-Sheet.png[/img]﻿[/quote][/spoiler]

[b][size=4]New Crafting Recipes[/size][/b]
[spoiler]
[size=4][quote][size=3][b][u]Stone Owl (Event) [/u]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][u]Recipe[/u]: x5 Owl Feather, x50 Stone, x1 Cindersap Warp Totem[/size]
[*][size=3][u]Acquisition[/u]: Get the owl statue event, you'll receive a letter from the Wizard.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u]Stone Owl (Decor)[/u]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][u]Recipe[/u]: x5 Owl Feather, x50 Stone[/size]
[*][size=3][u]Acquisition[/u]: Get the owl statue event, you'll receive a letter from the Wizard.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u][b]Curiosity Lure[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3][u]Recipe[/u]: x1 Owl Feather, x3 Gold Bars, x1 Ruby[/size]
[*][size=3][u]Acquisition[/u]: Mailed to you by Willy after shipping 5 owl feathers, or when you disable the Perfection config.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u]Cindersap Warp Totem[/u]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][u]Recipe[/u]: x5 Owl Feather, x25 Fiber, x1 Copper Bar[/size]
[*][size=3][u]Acquisition:[/u] Mailed to you after seeing the trippy Wizard event[/size]
[/list][size=3][/size]
[b][u][size=3]Owl Paintings
[/size][/u][/b][list]
[*][size=3][u]Recipe[/u]: x3 Owl Feather, x2 Dye Items, x20 Wood, x10 Fiber[/size]
[*][size=3][u]Acquisition:[/u] Read the book sent to you by Leah after an egg spawns in your world & you've played for 28 days.[/size]
[*][size=3][u]Note:[/u] The paintings displaying weird in the crafting menu is a [i]known issue[/i]. Don't report it![/size]
[*][size=3]If the visuals bother you, you can enable a config that allows you to buy the paintings from Marnie instead.[/size]
[/list][/quote][/size][/spoiler]

[b][size=4]New Farm Building - The Aviary[/size][/b]
[spoiler][quote]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/9kx0cGmm/Bog-Aviary-Spring.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*]Houses up to 12 animals
[*]Comes with an incubator and autofeeder
[*]Custom foresty interior map
[*]Custom music by TheFrenchDodo
[*]Intended for use with the owls, but you can house any animal here.
[*]Built in warp to the Wizard's Tower
[*]Drawn by the lovely BogWyytch!
[*]Costs 28000G, x300 Fiber, x100 Hardwood, x50 Refined Quartz
[*]Buildable after an owl egg spawns in your world. You will receive mail from Robin.
[/list][/quote][/spoiler]
[b]
[size=4]Wild Owl Spawns[/size][/b]
[spoiler][quote]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DPPCcH6S/wild.png[/img]
[list]
[*]While you're wandering the world, you may just spot a wild owl!
[*]They can spawn in all the available coloration for their species.
[/list][/quote][size=4][b][size=4][/spoiler][/size]
Misc Features:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[b][size=4]Gift Tastes For Feathers[/size][/b]
[quote][list]
[*][u]Loved [/u]- Elliott, Leo, Demetrius
[*][u]Like[/u] - Wizard, Emily, Harvey
[*][u]Dislike[/u] - Penny
[/list][/quote]
[b][size=4]Early Ostrich Incubator[/size][/b]
[quote][*]After building your first barn, you can purchase a "Large Incubator" from Marnie.
[*]It's just the Ostrich Incubator renamed
[*]It costs 10000G
[/quote]
[b][size=4]A Shiny Mechanic[/size][/b]
[quote][list]
[*]If you know me, you know I love Pokemon! Very, very rarely you can encounter golden owl eggs
[*]These owls drop lucrative gold produce when raised. Good luck hunting!
[/list][img]https://i.ibb.co/WvPNVGJ6/Owlet-Gold.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/LDbQFgck/Snowy-Owl-Gold.gif[/img][/quote][/spoiler]

* Added a new scare crow
* Added a new mail
* Adjusted potential drops for some owls
